title: Effects of Human Apical Papilla Cell Senescence on Repair-related Functions in Regenerative Endodontics
html: Senescence of human apical papilla cells (hAPCs) may impair their functional properties relevant to regenerative endodontic therapy. However, its impact on key cellular functions remains unclear. This study evaluated the effects of senescence on mitochondrial activity, morphology, functional behavior, and immunoinflammatory response of hAPCs.
